20 Jun

Public Forum: How to Save Seminary Pointe

June 20, 2026
12:00 pm - 1:30 pm
Monroe County Public Library, Auditorium
303 East Kirkwood Avenue, Bloomington, IN

You’re invited to come learn about the campaign to prevent the destruction of super-affordable apartments at Seminary Pointe, and how you can help.

Homes 4 All will present the vision and 5-year plan for the Seminary Pointe block and the key steps that need to be taken by project stakeholders and local decision-makers to preserve it. In the context of our current housing crisis, Homes 4 All will offer solutions guided by evidence-based cooperative models used locally—in Bloomington and the Midwest—that are already successful in improving affordability, the lives of tenants, and surrounding communities.

For more info, visit BH4A.org or email BloomingtonHomes4All@gmail.com
